182.csv::61.source_text:
移動中の戦士たちにも情報を共有して
効率よく補給ができるように
取り計らってもらわないとね――
182.csv::61.translated_text:
Must share the intel with soldiers on the move
too, bespeak matters so resupply runs efficient...
182.csv::61.speaker: Versa

182.csv::81.source_text:
あのさ、移動中の魔軍を見つけたんだ
そこまで重装備でも大隊でもないから
戦力を整えさえすれば、十分に勝機が見込めるよ
182.csv::81.translated_text:
We found a Demon Army unit on the move.
Not heavily armed, not e&amp;amp;#x27;en a full battalion—
ready our forces proper, and we&amp;amp;#x27;ve a
solid shot at victory.
182.csv::81.speaker: Dana

182.csv::39.source_text: 追跡開始します――時間内に痕跡を発見しましょう
182.csv::39.translated_text:
Pursuit begins — find the traces ere
time runs out.
182.csv::39.speaker: Guy

182.csv::49.source_text:
素材として使えそうな物の
サンプル収集をお願いね
これもスポット情報の調査には
欠かせないんだ
182.csv::49.translated_text:
Pray, gather samples of anything that might serve
as material—in truth, this too is essential to
the Spot Info investigation.
182.csv::49.speaker: Versa

182.csv::50.source_text:
そうね――
素材として使えそうな物の収集か
魔物出没状況の調査か
どちらかをお願いできない？
182.csv::50.translated_text:
I s&amp;amp;#x27;pose it comes down to this... Gather some
materials that might be of use, or perhaps track
where the monsters be lurking? Could I ask you to
do one or the other, eh?
182.csv::50.speaker: Versa

182.csv::83.source_text:
覚者さんも現地に向かってほしいんだ
一人じゃ危ないから、一緒に戦いやすい応援を
要請しておくのを忘れないでね
182.csv::83.translated_text:
I would have you, Ser Arisen, make for the site
as well. &amp;#x27;Tis too dangerous to go alone — I shall
see to it that proper backup is requested, the
sort that fights well alongside you. Do be sure
not to forget to put in the request.
182.csv::83.speaker: Dana

182.csv::84.source_text:
ふむ――
お考えがまとまったら
なるべく早めにご相談ください
182.csv::84.translated_text:
Hm— When your thoughts are settled...
Pray, come speak with me as soon as you are able.
182.csv::84.speaker: Artin

182.csv::302.source_text:
彼の者の討伐を――どうか――
火竜様なき今、あなただけが頼りなのです
182.csv::302.translated_text:
I beseech you— prithee, the subjugation of that
creature— For with Lord Fire Dragon gone, you
alone are the one upon whom we must rely.
182.csv::302.speaker: Doris

182.csv::25.source_text:
それでは、＜&amp;lt;STG 1093&amp;gt;＞へお急ぎください
協力者の方も、一足先に
現地で待っているはずですわ
182.csv::25.translated_text:
Then, pray make haste to &amp;lt;STG 1093&amp;gt;. 
Your collaborator awaits at the site,
having arrived afore you.
182.csv::25.speaker: Nazik

182.csv::413.source_text:
さぁ、各地から
イケてるメンズをスカウトしてきたわ
プレゼントの準備はいいかしら
182.csv::413.translated_text:
Well then, I’ve
scouted some really cool guys from all over.
Are you ready with your gifts?
182.csv::413.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::414.source_text:
今年も&quot;１人にだけ&quot;プレゼントしてね
他の人にはプレゼントできないから
よーく考えてから渡すのよ
182.csv::414.translated_text:
Please give a present to "just one person" again this year.
Since you can't give a present to anyone else,
make sure to think it over carefully before you give it.
182.csv::414.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::415.source_text:
それじゃあさっそく、全員から
アピールを聞いてみましょう！
182.csv::415.translated_text:
Well then, let's get right to it and
hear what everyone has to say!
182.csv::415.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::416.source_text:
今年のメンズもなかなかのイケメン揃いじゃないか
まあ、シェリーちゃん的には
俺は&quot;殿堂入り&quot;らしくてね
はっはっはっは！
182.csv::416.translated_text:
This year's men's lineup is pretty full of good-looking guys, isn't it?
Well, as far as Sherry-chan is concerned,
apparently I'm a "Hall of Famer."
Ha ha ha ha!
182.csv::416.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::417.source_text:
今年も&quot;１人にだけ&quot;プレゼントしてね
他の人にはプレゼントできないから
よーく考えてから渡すのよ
182.csv::417.translated_text:
Please give a present to "just one person" again this year.
Since you can't give a present to anyone else,
make sure to think it over carefully before you give it.
182.csv::417.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::418.source_text:
それじゃあさっそく、全員から
意気込みを聞いてみましょう！
182.csv::418.translated_text: Well then, let&#x27;s hear everyone&#x27;s resolve right away!
182.csv::418.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::419.source_text:
その顔は、まだ誰に贈るか悩んでいるな？
じっくりゆっくり考えていいぞ
182.csv::419.translated_text:
That face says you&#x27;re still mullin&#x27; over who to gift it to, eh?
Take your good time thinkin&#x27; it over.
182.csv::419.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::420.source_text:
なんなら俺が貰ってもいいんだが
ほら～、隣にシェリーちゃんという天使がいるもので
いやぁ悪いね！　悪いね～！
182.csv::420.translated_text:
Could always take it meself, s&#x27;pose.
See, I&#x27;ve got an angel by the name of Ms. Shelly right beside me.
My bad! My bad~!
182.csv::420.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::421.source_text:
ちゃんと気になる人にプレゼントできたみたいね
それじゃあ、今年の真に選ばれた男子が誰になるか
結果をお楽しみにね！
182.csv::421.translated_text:
Looks like you got that present to your special someone just fine!
Now then, who&#x27;ll be this year&#x27;s truly chosen fella?
Look forward to the results!
182.csv::421.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::422.source_text:
私？　私は今から
プレゼントを贈るところよ
182.csv::422.translated_text: Me? I&#x27;m just about to give a Present.
182.csv::422.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::423.source_text:
誰にって――決まってるじゃない！
私にはアンジェロしかいないわ！
182.csv::423.translated_text:
Who, you ask—&#x27;tis plain as day!
There&#x27;s no one for me but Angelo!
182.csv::423.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::424.source_text:
いやぁ、結果が楽しみだなぁ～！
ふっふっふ、そりゃあ余裕だよ
シェリーちゃんの一番は俺に決まってるからね
182.csv::424.translated_text:
My, I can&#x27;t wait to see the results!
Heh heh heh, easy enough.
After all, I&#x27;m a shoo-in for Shelly&#x27;s number one.
182.csv::424.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::425.source_text:
またコレか！
この手の祭りが始まると
エリオットがヤケにはりきりやがる
きっとまたうるせぇことになるぞ
182.csv::425.translated_text: Not this again! Whenever these festivals kick off, Elliot goes and gets himself all fired up. Bound to be a racket again.
182.csv::425.speaker: Gurdolin
